user.title: Grant Aerona3 Heat Pump (ASHP)
user.description: Enter your Grant Aerona3 heat pump's connection details. All entities will be created with 'ashp_' prefixes for better organisation.

data_description.host: The IP address of your Grant Aerona3 heat pump
data_description.scan_interval: How often to read data from the heat pump (recommended: 30 seconds)

features.title: System hardware
features.description: Tick the parts your heating system actually has. Only matching entities will be created and polled — you can change this later via Configure.

data_description.has_dhw_tank: Domestic hot water cylinder heated by the heat pump
data_description.has_ehs: External heat source for space heating (terminals 41-42)
data_description.has_cooling: System is configured to provide cooling as well as heating
data_description.zones: Choose 'dual' if you have a second (slave) heating zone
data_description.has_backup_heater: Electric backup/immersion heater fitted alongside the heat pump
data_description.has_humidity_sensor: Room humidity sensor wired to terminals 17-18
data_description.has_mixing_valve: 3-way mixing valve / low-loss header on terminals 4-5-6 and 13-14
data_description.has_remote_outdoor_sensor: Additional outdoor temperature probe wired to terminals 9-10
data_description.has_tariff_control: Wired to an economy-tariff or night-time noise-limiting signal (terminals 28-31)
data_description.has_advanced_config: Installer-only commissioning settings: frost-protection tuning, pump timing, error history, and terminal wiring switches. Set once, rarely touched again.

error.cannot_connect:
Failed to connect to the heat pump. Please check:
• TCP: IP address is correct, the heat pump is on the network, Modbus TCP is enabled, and port 502 is accessible
• Serial: the serial port path is correct, baud rate/parity/stop bits match the heat pump, and Home Assistant has permission to access the device

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured. Each heat pump can only be added once.

init.title: ASHP Integration Options
init.description: Adjust polling and tick the parts your heating system actually has. Changing hardware options reloads the integration and adds/removes the matching entities.

data_description.flow_rate_lpm: Water flow rate through the system for COP calculations (1-100 L/min)

data_description.experimental_flow_offset: Adds a flow offset number per zone that shifts the heating curve (or fixed flow setpoint) in 0.5 degree steps. New and lightly tested; off by default. Turning it off removes the entities.
data_description.max_flow_temp: Ceiling for the experimental flow offset. Defaults to 55; the unit allows up to 60.
data_description.room_trim_enabled: Slowly nudges the flow offset from a room temperature sensor of your choice. Needs the flow temperature offset above. Adds a climate entity. Turning it off removes the entity.

trim.title: Room temperature trim
trim.description:
Pick the room temperature sensor to follow (not the heat pump's own controller reading unless it sits in a representative room). Every interval the offset moves by at most 0.5 degrees, never beyond the limit below.

{coil7_warning}

data_description.room_trim_interval_min: How often the trim looks at the room (10-240 minutes). Heating systems respond slowly, so 30 or more is sensible.
data_description.room_trim_dead_band: No change while the room is within this distance of the target.
data_description.room_trim_cap: The trim never moves the offset beyond plus or minus this value.

error.trim_needs_offset: The room trim needs 'Experimental: flow temperature offset' to be ticked as well.
